# BO - Customers page - An exception is displayed when "Maximum number of payment days" invalid

In the BO > Customers > Customers page, when we Add/Edit a customer with invalid "Maximum number of payment days", an exception is displayed
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/155364924-6623030b-6e56-4c4a-ae1d-9e52fe8b3bf4.png)

## Étapes
1. Enable B2B in the BO > Shop Parameters > Customer Settings page
2. Go to BO > Customers > Customers page
2. Add/Edit a customer
3. Add the "Maximum number of payment days" field with a negative number
4. Save
5. See error
